fields.name: ShardKey
fields.definition: ArgentSea's immutable value type implementing the virtual compound key. It holds a shard id plus a record key of one to four columns: `ShardKey<TRecord>`, `ShardKey<TRecord, TChild>`, `ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>` and `ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild, TGreatGrandChild>`. It also embeds shard key type metadata. Equality compares the shard id and the key values. Because it is a struct it cannot be null: an absent key is `ShardKey.Empty` (shard 0, default key values), or the property is declared `Nullable<ShardKey<…>>`. It serializes to bytes, UTF-8 and an external key.
